messages.subject: Pennington Industries - section 20 request (our ref WM/DUD/2026/0117)
messages.plaintextBody:
Dear Ms Whitfield,

Further to my attendance on 15 January, please provide, under section 20 of the Health and Safety at Work etc. Act 1974: (1) the maintenance and function-test records for PT-DB-07 for the last 24 months; (2) the planned-maintenance schedule for guards/interlocks at the site; (3) training records for the injured operator; and (4) the safe system of work for swarf clearance. Please provide by 5 February 2026.

Karen Whitlow
HM Inspector of Health and Safety

messages.subject: RE: Pennington Industries - section 20 request (our ref WM/DUD/2026/0117)
messages.plaintextBody:
Dear Inspector Whitlow,

Thank you. We act for Pennington Industries Limited and all correspondence should now come to this firm. The Company will co-operate fully. We will collate the documents at items (1)-(4) and provide them by 5 February. We note the interlock switch has been retained and we are arranging an independent forensic examination, the report of which we will share once finalised.

Yours sincerely,
Sarah Whitfield, Whitfield Carter LLP

--
Whitfield Carter LLP
22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
Confidential and may be legally privileged.

messages.plaintextBody:
Dear Ms Whitfield,

Thank you for the documents. I confirm an Improvement Notice was served on 5 February regarding the maintenance regime. I should like to meet to discuss the maintenance records and the missed October test. Are you available on 4 March? I would also welcome the forensic report when ready.

Karen Whitlow
